in_marathi.name: चौधरी
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fort, strong, warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: चौधरी हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘chau’ which means ‘fort’ or ‘strong’, and ‘dhari’ which means ‘bearer’ or ‘holder’. This name is often given to boys in Hindu communities to symbolize strength, courage, and protection.

in_bengali.name: चौधरी
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Fort, strong, warrior
in_bengali.long_meaning: चौधरी একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘chau’ which means ‘fort’ or ‘strong’, and ‘dhari’ which means ‘bearer’ or ‘holder’. This name is often given to boys in Hindu communities to symbolize strength, courage, and protection.
